title: Mu'sha, the Left Eye of the Earthmother
wikitext:
[[File:Mu'sha, the Left Eye of the Earthmother.png|thumb]]
'''Mu'sha, the Left Eye of the Earthmother''' is a part of tauren mythology. It is recorded in-game on the shaman stone in the center of [[Moonhoof Village]].

{{Book|content=
Blessed are you, Matron of Night, for you shine over our heads each cycle. Your warmth and kindness have allowed us, the children of the earth, to survive each turmoil that was sent upon us.

Blessed are you, Matron of Night, for it was your tear that was wept at the cruelty of the world, and from it you gave birth to Lo’sho, our hope. Benevolent Matron, to you we bring praise.

Blessed are you, Matron of Night, for it was you who blessed our tribe. Whether it be grass, mud, or snow, we of the Moonhoof Tribe walk with you still, our hooves leaving trails of crescent moons wherever we step, the symbol of our bond.
}}
